text: Your Toronto Zoo is committed to expanding the voices and representation in our workplace. Our Equity, Diversity and Inclusion efforts are shaping our policies, procedures, and initiatives to demonstrate your Zoo’s commitment to Equity, Diversity and Inclusion principles. The team have embraced the spirit of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, with staff and volunteers across your Zoo participating in initiatives. The following report outlines the Initiatives the Toronto Zoo Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Steering Committee has implemented in 2021.
